connection.text: Connection Name*Give your connection a unique name to help you identify it in the future.SonarQube*SonarCloudSonarQube Server If you are using SonarQube Cloud, you do not need to enter the endpoint URL, which is https://sonarcloud.io/api/.Organization*Copy the organization key at here. If you have more than one, please create another connection.Token*A token with Browse permission on the projects you want is sufficient for listing projects and collecting issues, hotspots, and file metrics. Listing Accounts (users) may require a system admin token on some SonarQube instances.ProxyAdd a proxy if you cannot access SonarQube directly.Custom Rate LimitBy default, DevLake uses 10,000 requests/hour for data collection for SonarQube. But you can adjust the collection speed by setting up your desirable rate limit. Learn more
